messages:
Sam: Hi team — Acme is ready to sign but flagged a few last items: DPA redlines (liability cap), SLA uptime definition, and they want EFT invoice instructions. I attached the final order form. Can legal confirm quick?
Pat: on it. will review DPA appendix and liability. quick Q — do we have an SLA tail for maintenance windows spelled out in the order form?
Marie: SLA in the current draft is 99.9% monthly uptime with scheduled maintenance excluded (window: sun 02:00-05:00 UTC). Is Acme asking for anything stricter?
Alex (Acme): Sam — thanks. Correct, our procurement asked for a clearer definition around service credit calculation (how downtime measured) and to confirm who is the Data Controller vs Processor in the DPA. Also need EFT wiring fields for our AP team.
Sam: noted. Pat — they want explicit calc example for credits (e.g., downtime 43 minutes -> credit = X). Could you add a short formula?
Pat: yes. propose: credit = (minutes_down / total_minutes_in_month) * monthly_fee, rounded to nearest dollar. will add an example line. Also pushing back on reducing liability cap below 1x fees — is that acceptable?
Alex (Acme): Procurement prefers liability cap = fees paid in 12 months. Is Redwood ok with 12x?
Sam: customer asks 12x. Pat — can we accept 12x for this mid-market deal?
Pat: 12x is high but doable if we tighten indemnities and make explicit exclusions (e.g., indirect damages). I'll mark the MSA redline and DPA change. Need SLA exceptions listed and a CV of SOC2 status attached.
Marie: SOC2 Type II report is available — I'll upload a redacted copy to the thread (link). Also confirm our incident notification SLA: we notify within 1 hour for Sev1.
Alex (Acme): good. For EFT: please provide routing + remittance contact. Also they asked for invoice schedule (monthly in arrears) and PO number field on invoice.
Sam: EFT details below — please confirm with finance before routing:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Continental Bank
Account: 123456789
Routing (ABA): 021000021
SWIFT: FCBUS33
Remit: invoices@redwood.ai
```
Pat: confirm we'll include PO number line on invoices. Also recommend using DocuSign routing for signatures — faster for their procurement. Sam, can you trigger signature-bot once legal signs off? :thumbsup:
Signature Bot: Automated: prepared envelope 'Acme - Redwood Order Form + DPA' queued. Waiting for sender approval.
Sam: sending to Pat for legal sign-off now. Pat, pls ping here when you finish redlines (target EOD). Alex — once we have sign-ready, we'll route via DocuSign and send final invoice schedule.
Pat: redlines uploaded to SF drive (link). Key changes: 12x liability cap, added credit formula, clarified data roles as Processor = Redwood. I left a comment about backup retention in DPA — need Customer confirmation.
Alex (Acme): we'll review backup retention internally and revert by tomorrow. Also cc'ing AP on this thread. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Sam: great — I'll wait for your backup confirmation then trigger signature-bot. If procurement approves EFT, we can finalize onboarding kickoff next week.
